nights.title: Lauren Sanderson - Come Say Sum Tour EU/UK 2027
nights.name: Lauren Sanderson
nights.extract: Lauren Sanderson is an American singer and songwriter originally from Fort Wayne, Indiana, currently based in Nashville. Her music blends influences from pop, R&B and hip hop, and through it she aims to empower her fans and be "the voice for people who may not be able to speak".
